notes:
Single workbook, single NEW reschedule event found (only one file: Thermax_Loan_Reschedule.xlsx).

IMPORTANT CROSS-CHECK FINDING: The workbook's "Thermax_Loan", "Sheet1", "Sheet2", and "Repayment Schedule" tabs are byte-for-byte carryovers from the ORIGINAL loan file (Thermax Trade Ltd._Loan.xls) - verified by opening the original .xls (via xlrd/pandas) and confirming identical header parameters (15%/13% two-tier rate, 5yr tenor, Annuity, 48 installments-nominal/77 actual rows) and identical Sheet1/Sheet2 content (the Jul-Nov'09 overdue-interest capitalization of ~1,621,809.65 leading to a Dec'09 13%-rate 58-installment monthly schedule that fully amortizes to 0 by Sep 2014). That entire "1st rescheduling" (13% rate, Dec 2009) is therefore ALREADY baked into the ORIGINAL EX_DATA fixture in examples.ts (which uses override arrays ending at row 77, Oct 2014, closing 0, cumulative principal 32,915,472.97 = "Total Loan Amount after Capitalization" mentioned in the borrower notes) - it is NOT a separate reschedule event for this task.

The ONLY new content added in Thermax_Loan_Reschedule.xlsx relative to the original .xls is the "Accrual_Thermax" sheet's extension of columns from Oct-2014 out to May-2026, and the corresponding far-right columns (BY-CR range) of the "Thermax_Loan" sheet's quarterly schedule (32 rows from 2018-07-31 to 2026-04-30). This represents a genuine 2nd reschedule/restructure: effective 2018-01-01, principal outstanding at that point 31,437,853.07 (i.e., the loan was NOT actually repaid down to ~0 by 2014 as the paper 1st-reschedule schedule implied - it continued at that principal level with no borrower payments recorded 2014-2017 in this workbook), plus 2,448,280.19 of interest capitalized into a new opening balance of 33,886,133.27. Terms changed materially: rate 13% to 6%, tenor 5yr to 7yr, payment type Annuity to Level Principal, frequency changed to quarterly, 32 installments. Classified as RESTRUCTURE (not RATE_CHANGE) because rate, tenor, frequency, and principal type all changed together, and as RESTRUCTURE rather than RESCHEDULE because of the capitalization + tenor/type overhaul (a mechanical date-shift reschedule would only move payment dates).

Used the override-array approach per the assignment's guidance (THERMAX is one of the 5 override borrowers) since the quarterly principal amounts are not perfectly level (they grow ~1.5%/quarter, likely a level-principal-plus-growth-factor formula or manual smoothing) and cannot be cleanly regenerated from principal_type="Level Principal" alone - pinning every row to the workbook's actual values (openpyxl data_only read) is more accurate than reverse-engineering a formula.

Two figures in the workbook that were NOT used because they appear to be superseded/intermediate working values rather than the final capitalization: cell Thermax_Loan!BY36 "Capitalization for 2nd rescheduling: 5,708,266.35" (an earlier/alternate estimate, inconsistent with the confirmed Total = Principal outstanding 31,437,853.07 + Interest capitalized 2,448,280.19 = 33,886,133.27 in cells BY37:CA39, which ties exactly to the Accrual_Thermax opening balance from Jan 2018 onward and to every subsequent row in the quarterly schedule) - flagging this discrepancy in case it indicates an earlier, unused capitalization scenario worth confirming with IDCOL. No BB-approval reference, DFIM circular citation, or explicit waived amount was found anywhere in the workbook (searched all sheets/cells for "reschedul", "restructur", "approv", "circular" - only hit was the "Capitalization for 2nd rescheduling" label itself). waivedAmount = 0 (no forgiveness language found). Excel lock files (~$) were not present in the folder, only the target workbook and the unrelated original .xls loan file (which was referenced only for cross-verification, not as a source file to extract from, per the task's file list).
